Performance-driven digital marketer focused on growth, acquisition, and lifecycle optimization using data-led campaigns and product-marketing alignment.

Senior Digital Marketing Manager, CartNest — Jan 2023 - Present
Lead paid and organic acquisition initiatives for an ecommerce recovery platform. Designed and executed Google Ads search and shopping campaigns that reduced cost-per-acquisition by 32% while increasing recovered revenue from checkout reminders and retargeting. Developed Social Media Marketing strategies for short-form video and carousel ads, driving a 48% lift in click-through rates and improving audience retention across LinkedIn and Instagram. Implemented HubSpot flows for lifecycle email and SMS triggered from ad events, improving activation rate of trial users by 22%. Collaborated with product and engineering teams using Git and Agile practices, tracked work in Jira to shorten campaign-to-production cycle times.

Digital Marketing Manager, Finlytics — Sep 2020 - Dec 2022
Owned end-to-end digital campaigns for a B2B fintech analytics product. Launched SEO content program targeting high-intent keywords that grew organic demo requests by 60% year-over-year. Managed Google Ads account restructuring and bidding strategies, lowering cost-per-lead by 28% while increasing qualified pipeline. Ran Social Media Marketing for thought leadership and lead-gen, integrating paid and organic to lift MQL velocity. Coordinated cross-functional sprints using Agile methodologies and Jira; maintained creative and landing assets in Git.

Skills: SEO, Google Ads, Social Media Marketing, HubSpot, Git, Agile, Jira

Education: B.Des, NID Ahmedabad
